theorems.name: Submission.dgc_cylinder_volume
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (J : Finset ι) (B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)), volume {a : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι | (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : J => a i) ∈ B} ≤ volume B
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
